cobblewild.tip.sleepingbag: You can use a sleeping bag to sleep through the night without changing your respawn point.
cobblewild.tip.cobbleworkers: Pokemon in a pasture block can do helpful tasks around your base, like farming and generating loot.
cobblewild.tip.rustlingspots: Keep an eye out for rustling holes in the ground, they might contain valuable loot.
cobblewild.tip.pokemonfight: Let your Pokemon roam free! They can help you fight.
cobblewild.tip.chartingmap: You can use a Charting Map to create fast travel points connected by roads.
cobblewild.tip.chartingmap.water: Water and Lava count as valid path blocks when charting paths.
cobblewild.tip.suitcase: A Suitcase is a workstation for the Entrepreneur villager, where you can buy valuable items for legendary Pokemon.
cobblewild.tip.mirror: A Mirror can be used to fast travel to the nearest player also holding a Mirror.
cobblewild.tip.mirror.lodestone: Right click a Lodestone with a Mirror to bind them, then use the Mirror to return to the lodestone.
cobblewild.tip.spellbinding: Use a book in a Spell Binding table to pick a class.
cobblewild.tip.soulbound: You can enchant your equipment, including Curios, with Soulbound to keep them on death.
cobblewild.tip.simplyswords: Keep an eye out for rare, powerful weapons in loot.
cobblewild.tip.dummy: Craft a Target Dummy to attack and test out your damage.
cobblewild.tip.legendary: Place key items in pedestals found in monuments around the world to summon powerful Pokemon.
cobblewild.tip.quest: Lost on what to do? Check out the quests for some pointers.
cobblewild.tip.trainerspawner: Can't find your next trainer to battle? Craft a Trainer Spawner and place the correct spawning item inside.
cobblewild.tip.bosses: Defeat difficult bosses for valuable rewards from the quest page.
cobblewild.tip.otherside: Explore the Otherside to find difficult Pokemon raids.
cobblewild.tip.chipped: Craft a Chipped workbench to unlock a large collection of different styles for blocks to build with.
cobblewild.tip.spellbinding.scrolls: Find Spell Scrolls in loot to unlock new spells in a Spellbinding Table.
cobblewild.tip.spellbinding.unlock: Use a Spellbinding Table surrounded by bookshelves to unlock additional spells in your Spellbook.
cobblewild.tip.disenchant: Craft a Disenchanting Table to move valuable enchantments from equipment to enchanted books.
cobblewild.tip.decoration: Explore mods like Handcrafted for a variety of fun decoration blocks.
cobblewild.tip.lootr: Chest loot is per player, so everybody gets to loot the chest.
cobblewild.tip.lootr.opened: Golden chests have not been opened by you, and silver ones have been.
cobblewild.tip.juice: Feed your Pokemon Aprijuice to increase their riding stats.
cobblewild.tip.seasoning: Berries, golden carrots, and other items can be used as seasoning to add effects to Poke Bait, Poke Snacks, and more.
cobblewild.tip.fullness: If your Pokemon get full from eating too much, they will slowly recover over time.
cobblewild.tip.abilities: Ability Capsules and Ability Patches can be used to change a Pokemon's ability, including to its hidden ability.
cobblewild.tip.held: You can give your Pokemon items to hold that can help them in battle.
cobblewild.tip.mount: Ride your Pokemon to travel quickly over land, sea, and air.
cobblewild.tip.upgrades: Craft upgrades for your backpack and chests to provide valuable utility.
cobblewild.tip.farmers: Cook fancy foods in a Cooking Pot, some of them give helpful buffs.
cobblewild.tip.tmtr.find: Find TMs and TRs in loot to teach your Pokemon new moves.
cobblewild.tip.tmtr.learn: You can copy moves from your Pokemon onto a TM or a TR to then teach other Pokemon that move.
cobblewild.tip.plushies: Earn plushies from exploring and completing quests. Can you collect them all?
cobblewild.tip.megas: Some Pokemon can become Megas when given their stone, giving them a buff.
cobblewild.tip.tera: Terastallization allows your Pokemon to temporarily change their typing.
cobblewild.tip.dynamax: You can Dynamax your Pokemon to temporarily give them powerful buffs.
